correctness.rationale: The final theorem is correct for the displayed polynomial ODE on k1=0,k2=g,k3=0, with r>0 and g>0. Independently computed full generator L H = -g*x² +(g-k2)-k3*z +g(1+m)*k1*x*u/r; hence L H=-g*x² identically for all k4,k5,k6. For compactly supported invariant probability mu, d/dt E_mu H=0 gives E_mu x²=0 and supp(mu) subset {x=0}; invariance and uniqueness force y=0 (from xdot=r*y), then v=0 (from ydot=v), then u=0 (from vdot=-u), so supp(mu) lies on the equilibrium line. Conversely any measure supported on the line is stationary. A recurrent point has H(phi_t p) nonincreasing; return times approaching p force its time-integrated dissipation to vanish on every finite time interval, hence x(t) identically zero and the same tangency chain yields p on the line. This does NOT prove all orbits are bounded, nor all complete bounded orbits are equilibria: heteroclinic dynamics can remain. At the published parameters H=z+126*x²/61 and origin is exactly stationary. These conclusions are proved analytically, not from finite experiments.
